remarks: Brand new and beautifully designed, this stunning 2-storey home offers over 2,050 sq. ft. of modern living space with a sunny south-facing backyard and MOVE-IN-READY. The main floor features a rare bedroom and full 4-piece bath, perfect for guests or multi-generational living. The open-concept layout showcases a spacious kitchen with a walk-in pantry, flowing into the dining area and bright family room. A separate side entrance to the full unfinished basement offers excellent future suite potential (subject to approvals). Upstairs you'll find a large bonus room, convenient laundry with sink, two generous bedrooms, and a luxurious primary suite with a walk-in closet and spa-inspired 5-piece ensuite. Located just minutes from the new Big Lake commercial area, including a brand-new grocery store, this home perfectly combines style, comfort, and future potential. Photos are for marketing purposes only. Actual finishes and colours may vary. (id:67522)
